from build123d import *

# Overall dimensions
length = 80.0          # extrusion length
width = 12.3           # X extent (half of the full circle)
height = 30.8          # Y extent (full circle diameter)

radius = height / 2.0  # 15.4

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            # Straight chord on the right side
            Line((width, -radius), (width, radius))
            # Semi-circular arc on the left side
            ThreePointArc((width, radius), (-width, 0), (width, -radius))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=length)

part = p.part

from build123d import *
import math

# Overall dimensions
thickness = 17.9

# Star / gear outline
outer_radius = 39.6      # 79.2 across opposite points
root_radius = 35.0       # 64.2 A/F
points_count = 12

# Central through hole
central_hole_dia = 23.1

# Hex socket
hex_radius = 15.0
hex_depth = 4.0

# Build star polygon
pts = []
for i in range(points_count * 2):
    angle = i * math.pi / points_count
    r = outer_radius if i % 2 == 0 else root_radius
    pts.append((r * math.cos(angle), r * math.sin(angle)))

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Polygon(*pts)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid_body = p.part

# Central through hole
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, thickness / 2) * Cylinder(central_hole_dia / 2, thickness)

# Hex socket cut from top
with BuildPart() as hp:
    with BuildSketch() as hs:
        RegularPolygon(hex_radius, 6)
    extrude(amount=hex_depth)
hex_prism = Pos(0, 0, thickness - hex_depth) * hp.part
solid_body = solid_body - hex_prism

part = solid_body
part.name = "star_gear_with_hex_socket"
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

base_width = 71.36

base_height = 31.66

top_depth = 8.6

rib_width = 7.1

pocket_depth = 4.3
pocket_height = 27.2

# Rib

part = result
part.name = "stepped_block_with_holes"
